question: Renowned hypnotist BV Pattabhiram died at 75 years of age. Which record book recognized India’s first magic school, founded by him?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Limca Book of Records**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Renowned hypnotist BV Pattabhiram dies at 75.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Dr. BV Pattabhiram**, renowned **hypnotist, magician, and personality development expert**, passed away at **age 75** in **Hyderabad** due to **cardiac arrest**.

 
 
• 
 
He held a **PhD from Osmania University** for his thesis titled **“Yoga and Hypnotism — A Pragmatic Approach”**.

 
 
• 
 
He founded **India’s first magic school**, which was recognized by the **Limca Book of Records**.

 
 
• 
 
In **1983**, he received an **honorary doctorate** from the **University of Florida** for his contributions to hypnosis.

 
 
• 
 
He was also granted **honorary citizenship** by the mayors of **Nashville and New Orleans** in the USA.
